content.rationale: structured requirements with a runnable artifact dependent: conformance is what running the artifact shows, so the gate states the observables the requirements demand and leaves the verdict to the run. The grammar is read from src/styles/grammar.css and the drawing is the renderer's own markup on a fixture canvas, so every fixed visual value is checked against the rule that carries it and the drawn boxes, edges and arrowheads against the literals the requirements state; the toolbar is not read, because it is not the renderer's subject.
